name: Haan
age: PW (Physics Wallah) IPO jaisa case bhi ho sakta hai
column3: lekin ek difference samajhna zaroori hai.

name: PW ke time bhi logon ko GMP aur listing ko lekar doubt tha
age: kyunki company us waqt bhi accounting profit ke hisaab se bahut strong nahi thi. Lekin listing ke din stock ne lagbhag 33% premium par debut kiya.

name: Isse ek important baat samajh aati hai:
Loss-making company bhi achhi listing de sakti hai
age: agar market future growth par bharosa karta ho.

name: Aur profit-making company bhi discount par list ho sakti hai
age: agar valuation bahut mehenga ho ya demand kam ho.

name: Main sirf GMP dekhkar apply nahi karta. Main ye 5 cheezein dekhta:
toh loss-making company bhi achha perform kar sakti hai.
Lekin agar listing se 1–2 din pehle GMP tezi se girne lage ya QIB demand weak ho
age: to listing expectations bhi kam ho jati hain.

name: Isliye GMP ko signal samjho
age: guarantee nahi. Zerodha bhi yehi caution deta hai ki GMP unofficial hota hai aur IPO interest ko samajhne ke liye exchange par dikhne wale subscription numbers zyada reliable hote hain.
